title: Hadba indul a nemzet (1914) (Hungary Goes to War)
grammar: Past Conditional Volna in Historical Context, War Obligation & Epochal Connectors

sections.title: Lesson Goals
items: I can say how the war began in 1914 and what István Tisza thought of it.
I can say what would have happened differently, using the past conditional with volna.
I can use the words for the assassination, the declaration of war and mobilisation.
I can read a short account of the outbreak of war and answer questions about it.
